title: Trim Copilot Model List
description: There are too many extra models added to the Github copilot list that don't work or aren't desireable.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Code review detail: the extra GitHub Copilot models are not coming only from live provider discovery. MemorySmith also seeds a configured fallback list in `MemorySmithOptions.Chat.GitHubModels` and `appsettings.json`, currently including `gpt-4.1`, `gpt-4.1-mini`, `gpt-4o-mini`, `claude-3.5-haiku`, `gpt-5.1-mini`, `gpt-4o`, `gpt-5`, and `claude-sonnet-4.5`. This task should decide which of those configured fallbacks should remain visible when discovery is empty or incomplete.
